text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I visited a shrine together with Jungle Pocket, who had been feeling a bit off.
choice_data_list: Shall we go visit the shrine?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, I'm good.
Not really the devout type, anyway."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Pokke-chan!
What a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Yo, Top Road.
In that gear, are you in the middle of training?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's my roadwork route.
I always take a break right here.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Then that works out great.
Since you're here, why not relax with me for a bit?
choice_data_list: There's a place to sit over there.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Come to think of it,
it was like this back when I was on a team too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
We'd hang out at small shrines and stuff,
just shooting the breeze with the gang for hours.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh...! Were you always together
with your friends?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. Even with nothin' to do, we'd always
hang out together. Guess that's what a team is.”

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
How about your end?
Are you still showing your face at the team?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: A, a team...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? I told ya before, didn't I?
About how I used to run with my friends when I was little.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"When I was little...?
Oh, you mean back at the kids' club!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, everyone is full of energy, you know?
Just the other day, I went running with them!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh. ...Maybe I oughta go run
with them once in a while too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, there's this cafe I used to go to with my friends back in the day.
The old guy running it said he's handing it down to his son—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
And then—wait, crap!
The sun's already about to set!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wah, you're right.
When did this...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I'm sure Pokke-chan used to
spend time with her friends just like this in the past too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, you're right.
Heheh♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thanks to spending some relaxing time,
Jungle Pocket got her groove back.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, the other day—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, we've arrived.
Let us prepare for the tea party at once.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman A
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I'm sure everyone will be here very soon... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... looks like this place
is those old guys' turf.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Um, should we go somewhere else?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, I'll pass.
I'm not really in the mood anymore anyway."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Thanks. Let's hang out and shoot the breeze again sometime.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because she couldn't relax,
Jungle Pocket was unable to get back into top form...
